editor.subtitle: Write your announcement, choose recipients, then confirm publication
editor.contentHint: Choose a source and compose your announcement
editor.title: Title
editor.contentPlaceholder: Describe what is happening, its impact, and any action recipients should take
editor.templatePlaceholder: Search by template name or code
editor.templateHint: Choose an enabled template. Its category, level, and action defaults can be adjusted in advanced settings.
editor.variablesHint: Manual values are shared by all recipients; built-ins resolve per recipient. Template examples are never filled automatically.
editor.i18nHint: Use an existing translation key for both title and body. Parameters must be a JSON object; leave an empty object if no parameters are needed.
editor.markdownPreviewHint: In-app notifications currently display plain text, including Markdown syntax.
editor.templatePreviewEmpty: Choose a template and enter values to preview the notification.
editor.previewUnresolved: These parameters cannot be previewed: {{names}}. Check their values; complex formatting is resolved by the server.

editor.audienceHint: Choose who should receive this announcement
editor.audienceEstimate: This is a deduplicated scope estimate. Notification preferences are applied when sending.
editor.audienceUnion: Scopes are combined; each user receives the announcement once.
editor.directoryFailed: Directory loading failed. Retry or enter the exact code / ID.
editor.directoryForbidden: Directory access is unavailable. Enter the exact code / ID.
editor.timeHint: Choose when to publish and expire
editor.publishAtPlaceholder: Choose a future date and time
editor.scheduleHint: Time zone: {{timezone}}. Automatic sending starts only after scheduling is confirmed.
editor.expireHint: The announcement becomes unavailable after expiration. No expiration date is set for indefinite availability.
editor.mandatoryHint: Ignores users’ notification opt-outs. Use with care.
editor.reservedHint: This reserved category cannot be disabled by users.
editor.categoryHint: Categories support filtering and notification preferences. System announcement is usually appropriate.
editor.actionHint: Optionally provide an in-app destination. Otherwise, only the announcement content is shown.
editor.actionParamsHint: Use a registered application route name. Parameters must be a JSON object.
editor.draftHint: Saving a draft neither sends nor schedules it.
editor.confirmUnchecked: Recipient count has not been checked. Please verify the recipient scope.

editor.publishFailed: Publishing failed. The draft is preserved; you can retry.
editor.previewFailed: Recipient preview failed. Retry; this action does not save the announcement.
editor.loadFailed: The announcement could not be loaded. Reload before editing.
editor.templatesFailed: Templates could not be loaded. Retry.
editor.templatesForbidden: Template access is unavailable. Write directly or ask an administrator for access.
editor.audienceRequired: Select a role, department, or user for each recipient rule.
editor.variablesInvalid: These values do not match their declared types: {{names}}.
editor.categoryRequired: Choose a category in advanced settings.
editor.publishAtFuture: Scheduled publication must be in the future.
editor.expireAtInvalid: Expiration must be later than now and the publication time.
editor.i18nKeyInvalid: Enter a valid translation key, such as notification.maintenance.
editor.i18nParamsInvalid: Translation parameters must be a valid JSON object.
editor.actionRouteRequired: Enter a route name when navigation is enabled.
editor.actionParamsInvalid: Route parameters must be a valid JSON object.
editor.dynamicValue: Resolved for each recipient at publication
editor.builtinsHint: Built-ins require string parameters. Role names use “、” as a separator. Missing roles or department resolve to empty text; required empty values block publication.
editor.previewUserPlaceholder: Choose a user in the audience
editor.recipientPreviewHint: Preview uses current user details; final content is resolved at actual publication.
editor.personalizedPreviewEmpty: Choose a recipient and click Preview content to check built-in values.
editor.previewUsersFailed: Could not load preview users. Try again.
editor.contentPreviewFailed: Content preview failed. Check audience membership and required recipient fields.
editor.contentPreviewAudienceChanged: The audience has changed. This is the previous preview. Preview again to check that the user is in the new audience.
editor.contentPreviewForbidden: Content preview or user directory permission is unavailable. You can still configure and save the announcement.
editor.recipientFieldsMissing: Required recipient fields are empty: {{variables}}. Complete the user profile or switch these parameters to manual entry.
editor.actionChoiceHint: Choose the page opened by the announcement button, or show only the content with no action.
editor.actionMenuPlaceholder: Search and select a menu page
editor.actionDirectoryForbidden: You do not have permission to read menu targets. Saved bindings are retained; contact an administrator.
editor.actionDirectoryFailed: Could not load menu targets. Saved parameters are retained. Retry loading.
editor.actionDirectoryEmpty: No menu pages are available. Check page status and access permissions.
editor.actionTargetUnavailable: Menu target ({{id}}) is currently unavailable. Saved parameters are retained and will be checked on save or publish.

editor.actionQueryDescription: Enter the menu-defined query parameter {{name}} for page filters or display settings.
editor.actionUrlHint: Enter a complete HTTP or HTTPS address without a username or password. The link opens in a new window.
editor.actionLegacyHint: This announcement uses a legacy route action. The existing action is retained. Switch to System menu to select a page and enter each parameter.

editor.actionLabelOptionalPlaceholder: Leave blank to use the default language

editor.actionLabelFallback: Button uses the default language: {{locale}} (current language is empty).

editor.actionPreviewForbidden: You do not have permission to validate targets. Contact an administrator.
editor.actionPreviewFailed: Target validation failed. Check menu status, access permissions and parameters, then retry.
editor.actionOpenFailed: The target page cannot be opened. Check access permissions and validate it again.
editor.actionParametersUnknown: The menu no longer accepts these parameters: {{names}}. Select the menu again and enter its current parameters.
editor.actionUrlInvalid: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS address without a username or password.
editor.localizedHint: Shown in the recipient's current interface language; unconfigured languages use the default language.

editor.localizedParametersHint: Detected from all language versions. Values are shared across languages.
editor.localizedNoParameters: No shared parameters · no values are needed without placeholders
editor.localizedDefaultRequired: Complete the default language title and body.
editor.localizedPartial: Complete both fields for {{locale}}, or leave both empty to use the default language.
editor.localizedFallback: This preview language is incomplete. Using the default language: {{locale}}.

banner.modeHint: Persist at the top for all signed-in users, without inbox messages or unread counts.
banner.timeHint: Display at the start time, with an end time or manual takedown.
banner.expireHint: Without an end time, display until taken down or replaced.
banner.scheduledEditHint: This announcement is scheduled. Changes require confirmation again and cannot be saved as a draft. Cancel the plan to withdraw it.
banner.emptyCurrentHint: Top announcements published now appear here.
banner.emptyUpcomingHint: Schedule an announcement to review and adjust its plan here.
banner.replaceNowWarning: Confirming immediately replaces the current announcement and marks it superseded.
banner.publishNowHint: Confirming displays this announcement for all signed-in users now.
banner.keepUpcomingWarning: The upcoming announcement remains scheduled and will replace the active announcement at its start time.
banner.scheduleReplaceWarning: Keep the current announcement until this one starts; then replace whichever announcement is active.
banner.replaceUpcomingWarning: An upcoming announcement already exists. Confirming cancels that plan and replaces it with this one.
banner.noRestore: Replaced announcements never return automatically when the new one ends or is taken down.
banner.takeDownWarning: Take down this announcement now? It will stop being displayed.
banner.takeDownUpcoming: The upcoming announcement will still start as scheduled.
banner.cancelWarning: Cancel this scheduled announcement? The active announcement is unaffected.
banner.summaryFailed: Could not load top announcement status. Please refresh.
banner.editorSubtitle: Set content, severity and validity, then confirm display at the top
banner.previewHint: Persist at the top; open View details for the complete content
